data.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
data.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
data.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.
data.versionDescription:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.5 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-ios-unsigned

### New Features

- **player**: Animate circular feedback on transport buttons
- **albums**: Show formatted editorial descriptions
- **player**: Add Mornye media notification controls
- **lyrics**: Animate live previews while scrubbing playback
- **lyrics**: Add countdown dots for instrumental breaks
- **lyrics**: Add subtle lift to sustained word highlights
- **metadata**: Remove ReplayGain from individual and selected tracks
- **lyrics**: Show songwriter and provider credits after lyrics
- **concerts**: Show artwork-themed event details in app
- **player**: Add native audio output controls
- **artists**: Show provider-neutral upcoming concerts
- **lyrics**: Animate pronunciation and translation visibility
- **widgets**: Add native Android and iOS home screen players
- **navigation**: Refine translucent bottom bar and search folding
- **player**: Animate artwork transitions and immersive lyrics
- **player**: Expand compact track action menus
- **library**: Show saved animated artwork on local albums
- **library**: Refine album and artist artwork headers
- **player**: Scroll overflowing mini player titles and artists

### Bug Fixes

- **lyrics**: Slow instrumental dot pulse
- **metadata**: Restore cover artwork autofill
- **lyrics**: Pulse instrumental dots in unison
- **player**: Preserve lyrics state while switching to queue
- **player**: Match paused cover size during panel transitions
- **lyrics**: Pulse instrumental countdown dots
- **lyrics**: Smooth highlight lift and keep romanization still
- **android**: Bundle Discord SDK in local and CI releases
- **ui**: Correct glass shader coordinates on scaled tablets
- **lyrics**: Keep focus fixed when player controls hide
- Adapt Hi-Res analysis card to Mornye and clarify results
- Avoid inferring Hi-Res upsampling from bandwidth alone
- **ui**: Shorten ReplayGain removal selection labels
- **lyrics**: Align pronunciation phrases and improve readability
- **ui**: Allow landscape only in the full player
- **android**: Avoid blocked statx probes on legacy ARM32 devices
- **ci**: Require verified V1 V2 V3 release APK signatures
- **lyrics**: Soften landscape footer and use neutral tab colors
- **lyrics**: Hide controls after five seconds only during playback
- **player**: Move track header with the cover between panels
- **artists**: Tighten concert badge and logo spacing
- **concerts**: Follow the selected light or dark theme
- **settings**: Remove extension row icons and correct online colors
- **player**: Preserve playlist context when playing a track
- **library**: Keep album batch actions alive after selection closes
- **artwork**: Preserve cover colors and readable player contrast
- **ios**: Adopt the UIScene lifecycle required on iOS 27 by [@BartolomeoRusso9](https://github.com/BartolomeoRusso9)
- **player**: Loop marquee forward with longer reading pauses

### Refactoring

- **discord**: Remove rich presence and bundled SDK

### Styling

- Slim down the upcoming concerts badge
- Simplify track metadata card headings
- **player**: Reduce paused play glyph without shifting controls
- **loading**: Match the compact artist header spacing
- **lyrics**: Use compact liquid glass language menu
- **settings**: Simplify grouped rows and use green switches

### Testing

- **l10n**: Match Indonesian tutorial terminology

### Dependencies

- **deps**: Update Flutter Rust and Android dependencies

### Chores

- **release**: Bump app version to 5.0.5
- **git**: Ignore Swift package build artifacts
- **release**: Bump app version to 5.0.1+153
- Update AltStore source to v5.0.0 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])

### Build

- **android**: Enable all release APK signing schemes


### New Contributors
* @BartolomeoRusso9 made their first contribution



**Full Changelog**: [v5.0.0...v5.0.5](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v5.0.0...v5.0.5)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-arm32.apk` (older devices)

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.5-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA
